$comment: Directive grammar of open77.lua, the Open77 resource manifest. Written by wiki/tools/extract-schemas.py and checked against the server's manifest parser. The manifest is Lua syntax: `directive "value"`, `directive true`, or `directives { "a", "b" }`; a singular directive may repeat.

limits.resourceName: lowercase slug, letters, digits and underscores, 3 to 64 characters, starting with a letter; must equal the directory name

directives.name: resource
directives.description: The resource name; must match the directory name.

directives.name: version
directives.description: The resource version, semantic version recommended.

directives.name: open77_version
directives.description: The platform version range this resource targets; `*` for any.

directives.name: auto_start
directives.description: Whether the server starts the resource when it is discovered.

directives.name: reload_policy
directives.description: How a changed resource is republished to a running session; `transactional` prepares a new generation and switches once verified.

directives.name: dependencies
directives.description: Resource names that must be running before this one starts.

directives.name: permissions
directives.description: Manifest permissions the resource needs; see permissions.json. A native whose permission is not declared answers `permission_denied:<name>`.

directives.name: shared_scripts
directives.description: Lua files loaded on both runtimes; globs allowed; `.lua` only.

directives.name: server_scripts
directives.description: Lua files loaded by the dedicated server; globs allowed; `.lua` only.

directives.name: client_scripts
directives.description: Lua files delivered to and run by the game client; globs allowed; `.lua` only.

directives.name: files
directives.description: Extra files delivered to the client (data, images); globs allowed.

directives.name: web_files
directives.description: WebUI files (HTML, CSS, JS) delivered to the client; globs allowed.

directives.name: preload_mods
directives.description: Mod packages (archives) the client must have before the game starts; each pattern must match at least one file. See the Mods guide.

directives.name: exports
directives.description: Declarative client exports, FiveM's `exports { ... }`: names of global functions the client scripts define, published as exports without a call to `exports()`, after the last client script ran. A name that is not a global function by then fails the start with `manifest_export_missing:<name>`. Names are `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$`. See the resource-exports and lua-modules guides.

directives.name: server_exports
directives.description: Declarative server exports, FiveM's `server_exports { ... }`: the same rule for the dedicated server's scripts, registered through the same `exports(name, fn)` path (so the runtime's limits and replace-on-duplicate rule apply). Names are `^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{0,63}$`.

example:
resource "hello"
version "1.0.0"
auto_start true

permissions { "network.events", "hud.notify" }
dependency "open77_zones"

shared_script "shared/config.lua"
client_script "client/main.lua"
server_script "server/main.lua"
web_files { "web/**" }
